F011.summary: Database migrations fully set up with Drizzle-kit, auto-run on server start, version tracking via journal, and rollback capability

Migrations generated successfully.detail: 7 migration SQL files (0000-0006) generated in packages/db/src/migrations/. Each has corresponding snapshot JSON.

Migrations run on server start.detail: apps/server/src/index.ts:21-26 calls runMigrations() at server startup, exits process on failure.

Schema version tracked.detail: Drizzle-kit maintains _journal.json with version tracking. Current journal version: 7, dialect: sqlite, 7 entries with idx, version, timestamps, and tags.

Rollback capability exists.detail: packages/db/src/migrate.ts exports rollbackDatabase() which restores from .bak file. backupDatabase() runs automatically before migrations. Both exported from db package.

F012.summary: Project repository has full CRUD with type-safe returns, error handling, and transaction support

All CRUD methods implemented.detail: findAll, findById, findByUser, findByPath, create, update, delete methods implemented. Create generates ID if not provided.

Type-safe return values.detail: All methods return Promise<ProjectSelect> or Promise<ProjectSelect[]> using Drizzle's $inferSelect type inference.

Error handling for not found.detail: update() and delete() throw Error with descriptive messages when row not found. create() throws if insertion returns no row.

Transaction support.detail: withTransaction() method wraps callback in db.transaction(). Type-safe tx parameter.

F013.summary: Feature repository has comprehensive CRUD, multi-criteria queries, bulk status updates with validation, and dependency resolution

CRUD methods implemented.detail: findAll, findById, findByUser, create, update, delete plus many query variants (findByStatus, findByPhase, findByProject, etc.).

Query by project and status.detail: findByProject(projectId), findByStatus(status), findByUserAndStatus(userId, status), findByStatusAndPhase(status, phase), findByUserStatusAndPhase(userId, status, phase), findByUserAndProject(userId, projectId).

Bulk status updates work.detail: bulkUpdateStatus(ids, status) and bulkUpdateStatusWithValidation(ids, status, validTransitions) both use transactions. Validation version checks state machine transitions before updating.

Dependency resolution query.detail: findDependencies(id) reads feature's dependencies JSON array and queries for all dependent feature records. findByProjectWithDependencies also available.

F014.summary: Session repository has CRUD, active session query, output append, and duration calculation

Session CRUD implemented.detail: findAll, findById, findByFeature, findByStatus, create, update, delete methods. Auto-generates session ID if not provided.

Active session query works.detail: findActive() returns sessions with status IN ('pending', 'running').

Output append capability.detail: appendOutput(id, text) uses SQL CASE expression to concatenate text to existing output, or set it if null. Uses char(10) as newline separator.

Duration calculation.detail: calculateDuration(session) computes elapsed milliseconds between startedAt and completedAt. Handles both Date objects and numeric timestamps. Returns null if session not complete.

F015.summary: Hono server fully configured with oRPC, CORS, security headers, rate limiting, error handling, WebSocket support

Hono framework configured.detail: apps/server/src/index.ts creates Hono app with full middleware stack. Exports Bun-native server config with fetch and websocket handlers.

oRPC integration working.detail: Both OpenAPIHandler and RPCHandler configured with appRouter. RPC at /rpc prefix, OpenAPI at /api-reference prefix. Error interceptors configured.

CORS configured.detail: CORS middleware supports comma-separated origins from env.CORS_ORIGIN. Allows GET/POST/OPTIONS with Content-Type and Authorization headers. Credentials enabled.

Error handling middleware.detail: Global error handler at app.onError catches HTTPException and generic errors. Production mode hides error details. Also has 404 handler with SPA fallback.

F016.summary: Health check endpoint returns status, version, DB connectivity, and uptime. Also has /ready endpoint.

GET /health returns 200.detail: GET /health returns 200 when healthy, 503 when DB disconnected.

Response includes version.detail: Response includes version: '0.1.0' in JSON body.

Database connectivity checked.detail: Executes db.run(sql`SELECT 1`) to verify DB connection. Returns 'connected' or 'disconnected' status.

Response time under 100ms.detail: Only performs a simple SELECT 1 query — should be well under 100ms for SQLite. No explicit timing measurement but the operation is trivially fast.
